text:
Ava: Quick check — RFC review today 3:00pm PT. We have six short RFCs + one deep design. Can people call ordering prefs? trying to put fast wins first so we don’t run out of time.
Mohit: +1 to fast wins first. My order: 3, 1, 4, 2, 5, 6 then deep design last.
Diego: I can only make first half. prefer 1,3,2 up front.
Sam: Heads up — I’ll compile TL;DR bullets for each RFC if authors drop them here by 11:30am. that’ll speed the meeting.
Lena: I’m out 3:15–3:35, so please put my RFC (PR #342) before that window if possible.
Ava: Noted Lena. PR #342 = RFC 4. we’ll try to place it early.
Priya: I suggest grouping related infra changes (RFC 1 + RFC 2) back-to-back so reviewers can stay in context.
Mohit: Good call. so maybe group 1+2, then quick feature 3, then Lena 4, then 5+6, then deep design.
Ava: Draft agenda idea (vote with :one: :two: reactions or reply):
```
1) RFC 1 (infra) - 10m
2) RFC 2 (infra) - 8m
3) RFC 3 (feature) - 6m
4) RFC 4 (Lena) - 7m
5) RFC 5 (docs/tooling) - 5m
6) RFC 6 (ops tweak) - 5m
7) Deep design - 20m
```
Sam: I’ll produce a 1-line TL;DR table and paste in this thread once authors post bullets. helps the chair move quickly.
Lena: Posted TL;DRs for RFC 4 in the doc: https://docs.internal/rfcs/342 — short bullets under Summary.
Priya: I added notes on coupling for RFC 1/2 in the doc.
Diego: For availability: I can stay until 3:20. if we can get my item at #3 that works.
Ava: Clocking constraints: we have 45 minutes total. if we miss the deep design we can spin it out to next week and do a quick action item list.
Mohit: If people are okay with skipping deep design unless we have reviewers assigned and a clear decision ask.
Sam: Agree — deep design needs pre-assigned reviewers. I can volunteer to read but cannot commit to decision today.
Ava: Action items before 11:30am: authors add 1-2 bullets TL;DR here or in doc; reviewers claim which RFCs they’ll own; post any blocking questions.
Priya: Claiming RFC 1 and 2 review.
Mohit: Claiming RFC 3.
:deploy-bot: Meeting created: RFC Review — 03:00 PM PT (45m) — link https://meet.company/r/xyz :calendar:
Ava: OK locking tentative order per votes + constraints: 1,2,3,4,5,6, deep design last. I’ll update the meeting agenda and ping again at 12:00. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: I’ll paste the TL;DR table by 11:10.
Lena: Thanks — will be on for my slot.
Priya: LGTM
Diego: Thanks, see you in the morning (well, afternoon)
Ava: Reminder at 12:00 I’ll post the final agenda and chair notes. If anyone needs swaps, DM me by noon.
